name: ci-sentinel-mcp
description: Security auditor for SEVEN CI ecosystems — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines, Bitbucket Pipelines and Travis CI — as an MCP tool with a LIVE threat-intelligence feed of known-compromised CI components. Detects script/command injection, pull_request_target/workflow_run pwn requests, excessive GITHUB_TOKEN/CI_JOB_TOKEN permissions, unpinned/transitive third-party actions, self-hosted runner RCE, OIDC misuse and supply-chain hijacks (e.g. tj-actions/changed-files CVE-2025-30066). Free quick verdict; deep audit (file:line, full taint path, action graph, SARIF, fixes) via x402 USDC micropayment or a prepaid card key.
author: ci-sentinel
